name: Interdisciplinary Program in Quantitative Biosciences (IPQB) PhD
detailsNote: The program's apply page gives its deadline as 'December, 16th 2027!' which cannot be a Fall 2027 entry deadline, so it is published as written and not used as a date. The fee amount, funding and admission model are not stated on the pages checked. Applicants apply through the Biochemistry and Molecular Biology degree choice.
summary: Interdisciplinary quantitative biosciences PhD at UC Santa Barbara. Applicants should have strong backgrounds in biochemistry, biology, chemistry, engineering or physics.

publishedDeadlines.label: Application deadline (as published)
publishedDeadlines.note: Exact text from the IQB apply page; it does not match the Fall 2027 entry cycle, so it is not used for countdowns. Confirm the real date with the program.

english.toefl: 4.0 minimum for exams taken on or after January 21, 2026; 80 for exams taken before that date
english.note: Required for international students from non-English-speaking countries, except those with a bachelor's degree from an accredited US institution where English is the principal language. The Graduate Division also names IELTS and the Duolingo English Test as accepted tests; no minimums are stated for them.

requirements.note: The IQB page says GRE scores are not required for the 2027 admission cycle. To apply you must choose the Biochemistry and Molecular Biology degree in the application. Applicants pay a fee with the electronic application; the amount is not stated. The Graduate Division asks fee waiver requests to be made at least one week before the deadline.
